_comment: Shared cross-implementation contract for the Plan 094 Phase 14 E2E stack attestation. Asserted verbatim by Go, Bun, Vitest, and the gate selftests so the four implementations cannot drift. Do not edit a value without changing all four.

contract.keyDerivation: h = sha256(ASCII bytes of the nonce string); objid = parseInt(h.hex[0..8], 16) & 0x7fffffff; key = (lockClass << 32) | objid, a positive bigint
contract.gateLockStatement: SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock($1::bigint)  -- inside an open transaction on ONE reserved connection
contract.observeQuery: SELECT current_database(), EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_database d ON d.oid = l.database WHERE d.datname = current_database() AND l.locktype = 'advisory' AND l.classid = $1::int8::oid AND l.objid = $2::int8::oid AND l.objsubid = 1 AND l.granted)

refusal.go: the router's own NotFound response, byte-identical to an unregistered path
refusal.next: notFound() from next/navigation, identical to an absent route
refusal.hocuspocus: do not handle the request: fall through to the server's default unhandled response

hostExposure.name: BRIDGE_HOST_EXPOSURE
hostExposure.normalization: trim ASCII whitespace (space, tab, CR, LF), then compare case-insensitively; only the exact word declares exposure. Only ASCII whitespace is contracted: Go's strings.TrimSpace and JavaScript's String.prototype.trim disagree on a few non-ASCII code points (U+0085, U+FEFF), which no environment file should contain and which these cases deliberately do not pin.
hostExposure.rule: when the flag is on and the normalized value is 'exposed', the service refuses unless the tunnel opt-in is exactly 'true' — Go and Hocuspocus at start-up, Next.js per request

observeConcurrency.rule: at most this many observe queries may be in flight per process; an excess request is refused exactly like any other refusal and runs NO query. The gate samples sequentially, so legitimate traffic never exceeds 1.

contract.realtimeUrlHandling: The Hocuspocus attestation is probed at the base URL derived from NEXT_PUBLIC_HOCUSPOCUS_URL (ws->http, wss->https), with its base PATH preserved, plus the hocuspocus path suffix. So ws://host:3100/hocuspocus is probed at http://host:3100/hocuspocus/e2e-stack, and the Hocuspocus onRequest handler matches any pathname ending in /e2e-stack. This supports a single-port reverse proxy that mounts Hocuspocus under a prefix (deploy/nginx/bridge.conf).
